Hadith.2290 - It has been narrated:
The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) departed from Mina through the road of Dabb
and returned through the path between the two mountain passes.
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) would not return on the same path he had taken.
